examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the Workloads page places it: the product name as overline, the headline and lead over five feature screens, each with its own illustration and a link out to the documentation. From the large breakpoint up the features run through the sticky stack with the illustration pinned; below it they fall into a three-column grid of media tiles. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.
